words.definition_en: to give work to someone and pay them for it.
collocations: employ sb. to VR（僱用某人做某事）
words.sentence_en: The company plans to employ more workers next year.
words.sentence_tw: 這家公司計畫明年僱用更多工人。
words.analysis: 動詞表示僱用，衍生詞包含 employer（雇主）、employee（員工）與 unemployment（失業）。
words.timing: 討論職場、就業機會、公司營運或招募員工時使用。

words.definition_en: a large company or group of companies acting together as a single organization.
words.sentence_en: She works as a manager in a multinational corporation.
words.sentence_tw: 她在一家跨國企業擔任經理。
words.analysis: 通常指規模龐大的企業集團或股份有限公司。形容詞為 corporate。
words.timing: 談論商業經濟、大型企業或職場環境時。

words.definition_en: to experience or be affected by something bad, such as pain, illness, or sadness.
collocations: suffer from + 疾病/困難（患有⋯疾病/受⋯之苦）
words.sentence_en: Many elderly people suffer from chronic joint pain.
words.sentence_tw: 許多長者飽受慢性關節疼痛之苦。
words.analysis: suffer from 後面常接具體的疾病、飢餓或困境，表示「遭受……之苦」。
words.timing: 描述病情、心理煎熬、天災人禍或痛苦經驗時。

words.definition_en: forming or situated at the end or extremity; incurable and leading to death.
words.sentence_en: The airport's new terminal handles international flights.
words.sentence_tw: 機場的新航廈負責處理國際航班。
words.analysis: 當形容詞時可指末期的（絕症）；當名詞時可指交通終點站或機場航廈。
words.timing: 談論醫療重症議題或搭機旅遊時。

words.definition_en: a disease or period of sickness affecting the body or mind.
words.sentence_en: He had to stay home from school due to a sudden illness.
words.sentence_tw: 由於突發疾病，他不得不請假留在家裡。
words.analysis: 泛指身體或心理的生病狀態。動詞片語 fall ill 表示「生病、得病」。
words.timing: 談論健康狀況、醫療保健或請假原因時。

words.definition_en: to a great extent; extremely or enormously.
words.sentence_en: Her support helped me tremendously during difficult times.
words.sentence_tw: 在艱難的時期，她的支持對我幫助極大。
words.analysis: 副詞修飾動詞或形容詞，表示程度非常深。形容詞為 tremendous。
words.timing: 誇飾程度、強調感謝或描述巨大轉變時。

words.definition_en: the action or sound of laughing.
collocations: roar with laughter（大笑/仰天長笑）
words.sentence_en: The comedian's joke filled the room with laughter.
words.sentence_tw: 喜劇演員的笑話讓整個房間充滿了笑聲。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，專指笑聲或笑的行為。常搭配 burst into 或 roar with 等動詞片語。
words.timing: 描述歡樂氣氛、喜劇效果或社交互動時。

words.definition_en: make (someone) afraid or anxious.
collocations: frighten sb. to death（把某人嚇得要死）
words.sentence_en: Loud thunder can easily frighten small children.
words.sentence_tw: 巨大的雷聲很容易嚇到小孩子。
words.analysis: 指讓某人產生驚嚇或恐懼感。常見誇飾用語 frighten sb. to death（嚇死某人）。
words.timing: 描述恐怖經驗、驚嚇反應或緊張情境時。

words.definition_en: the state or condition of physical touching or communicating; to communicate with.
collocations: keep in contact with...（與⋯保持聯絡）
words.sentence_en: It is important to keep in contact with old friends.
words.sentence_tw: 與老朋友保持聯絡是很重要的。
words.analysis: 既可作名詞（接觸/人脈），也可作動詞（聯繫某人）。
words.timing: 討論人際關係、通訊方式或衛生防疫（接觸史）時。

words.definition_en: a microorganism, especially one that causes disease.
words.sentence_en: Wash your hands frequently to prevent germs from spreading.
words.sentence_tw: 經常洗手以防止病菌傳播。
words.analysis: 可數名詞，通常用複數形 germs 指肉眼看不見的致病細菌或病毒。
words.timing: 衛生教育、提醒洗手防病或談論健康習慣時。

words.definition_en: the state or quality of being warm; enthusiasm and affection.
words.sentence_en: She felt the warmth of the sun on her face.
words.sentence_tw: 她感受到陽光灑在臉上的溫暖。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，除了指物理上的溫度溫暖，也常用來形容人際間的情感熱情。
words.timing: 形容天氣、房間溫度，或稱讚某人待人親切熱情時。

words.definition_en: (of a person) weak and delicate; physically weak.
words.sentence_en: Despite his frail health, he still works hard every day.
words.sentence_tw: 儘管身體虛弱，他每天仍然努力工作。
words.analysis: 形容人體弱多病、衰老虛弱，或指物品脆弱易碎。
words.timing: 描述老人體態、病人狀況或脆弱易壞的事物時。

words.definition_en: to encourage someone to take action; done without delay.
collocations: prompt sb. to VR（促使某人做某事）
words.sentence_en: His kind words prompted me to keep trying.
words.sentence_tw: 他溫暖的話語促使我繼續嘗試。
words.analysis: 作動詞時常搭配 prompt sb. to V；作形容詞時指迅速、即時的（prompt reply）。
words.timing: 描述動機、激勵原因或要求即時回應時。

words.definition_en: keep or restrict someone or something within certain limits.
collocations: be confined to + N/地點（被限制在⋯/臥病在床上）
words.sentence_en: Due to a severe injury, he was confined to bed for weeks.
words.sentence_tw: 由於嚴重的受傷，他臥病在床數週。
words.analysis: 常以被動語態 be confined to 出現，表示被侷限在某個空間、狀況或病榻上。
words.timing: 描述行動受限、病情嚴重臥床或活動範圍受規範時。

words.definition_en: shine brightly with flashes of light; a small flash of light.
words.sentence_en: The stars began to sparkle in the clear night sky.
words.sentence_tw: 星星在晴朗的夜空中開始閃爍。
words.analysis: 既可作動詞表閃耀，也可作名詞指閃光或眼中的神采、火花。
words.timing: 描繪夜景、珠寶光澤或眼睛充滿希望的光芒時。

words.definition_en: an act of squeezing someone tightly in one's arms, typically to express affection.
collocations: give sb. a hug（給某人一個擁抱）
words.sentence_en: The little girl ran to her mother and gave her a warm hug.
words.sentence_tw: 小女孩跑向媽媽，給了他一個溫暖的擁抱。
words.analysis: 可數名詞與動詞同型。常用於表達安慰、喜悅或道別時的肢體接觸。
words.timing: 描述溫馨感人場景、安慰朋友或家人重逢時。

words.definition_en: sleepy and lethargic; half asleep.
words.sentence_en: The warm room made her feel very drowsy after lunch.
words.sentence_tw: 溫暖的房間讓她在午餐後感到非常昏昏欲睡。
words.analysis: 形容人因疲倦、藥物或環境而想睡覺。名詞為 drowsiness。
words.timing: 描述熬夜後、下午精神不濟或服藥後的狀態時。

words.definition_en: to straighten or extend one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.
collocations: stretch out one's arm(s)（伸出雙臂）
words.sentence_en: It is good practice to stretch before doing exercise.
words.sentence_tw: 運動前進行伸展是很好的習慣。
words.analysis: 指肌肉、肢體或物體的拉伸、伸展動作。
words.timing: 運動健身、剛睡醒伸懶腰或伸出雙手拿東西時。

words.definition_en: to indicate or show that one is not willing to do something.
words.sentence_en: He refused to give up despite the difficult circumstances.
words.sentence_tw: 儘管環境艱難，他仍拒絕放棄。
words.analysis: 核心用法為 refuse to V。名詞為 refusal。
words.timing: 拒絕不合理要求、堅持原則或談判破裂時。

words.definition_en: to pause before saying or doing something, often because of uncertainty.
words.sentence_en: If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to ask.
words.sentence_tw: 如果你有任何問題，請毫不猶豫地提出來。
words.analysis: 常用於否定句中「do not hesitate to V」（儘管去做/毫不猶豫）。名詞為 hesitation。
words.timing: 鼓勵他人大膽發問、做決定前舉棋不定或感到困惑時。

phrases.sentence_en: She decided to pass on her skills to the younger generation.
phrases.sentence_tw: 她決定將自己的技能傳給年輕一代。
phrases.analysis: 指將物品、知識、訊息或傳統代代相傳或轉交給其他人。

phrases.sentence_en: We bought some flowers to cheer our sick friend up.
phrases.sentence_tw: 我們買了一些花來讓生病的朋友振作起來。
phrases.analysis: 可分開式片語（名詞放中間或後面皆可，代名詞只能放中間 cheer him up）。

phrases.sentence_en: He had to turn down the job offer because of personal reasons.
phrases.sentence_tw: 由於個人原因，他不得不拒絕這份工作邀約。
phrases.analysis: 除了拒絕提議、請求或工作機會外，也可指將音量、火力調小（turn down the music）。

phrases.sentence_en: The train was about to leave when we finally reached the station.
phrases.sentence_tw: 當我們終於抵達車站時，火車正要開走。

phrases.sentence_en: Don't be too hard on him; he is only a child, after all.
phrases.sentence_tw: 對他不要太苛刻；畢竟他還只是個孩子。

phrases.sentence_en: His grandfather passed away peacefully at the age of ninety.
phrases.sentence_tw: 他的爺爺在九十歲時安詳過世。

phrases.sentence_en: Small daily habits can truly make a difference in your health.
phrases.sentence_tw: 每天的小習慣真的能對你的健康帶來改變。

patterns.title: 句型：虛受詞 it 用法 (find / consider / feel / think + it + adj./N + to VR)
patterns.structure: 主詞 + 動詞 (find/consider/think/feel) + it + 形容詞/名詞 + to + 動詞原形 (若需指明對象可加 for + 人)
patterns.explanation: 此句型利用虛受詞 it 代表後面的真受詞（不定詞片語 to + VR），用以避免受詞太長而導致頭重腳輕。常見動詞包含 find, consider, think, feel 等。
patterns.sentence_en: Many students find it challenging to learn a new language.
patterns.sentence_tw: 許多學生發現學習一門新語言具有挑戰性。
examples: The teacher thinks it important for us to practice English every day.
She considers it her duty to help people in need.
I found it difficult to finish the report on time.
